biggest_catch: The $25 only pays if the friend establishes direct deposit into the new checking account within 6 months - and the bonus lands up to 30 days after that, with gig-economy and digital-wallet deposits excluded.
catches: $25 to you and $25 to your friend when the friend opens a new checking account with direct deposit.
Direct deposit must be established within 6 months of account opening; excludes digital-wallet deposits and gig-economy/self-employment income.
Bonus deposited to each account within 30 days of the direct deposit landing.
New-member checking accounts only; existing CCCU checking accounts do not qualify.
Referral form or promo code RAF must be referenced at application (use RAF for online applications); referring member must be in good standing.
Minimum $5 to open membership; bonus may be reported to the IRS.
